title: Ten Days and a Cup of Water
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler of quiet wisdom, and tonight Daniel chooses quietly and wisely far from home, asking kindly for ten days of vegetables and water. Wren choosing her apple slices first, without telling anybody, is the same small, strong choice.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because Daniel chose quietly and wisely, and quiet wisdom is Wren’s gift. In Wren’s world today: at snack time everyone reaches for the cookies first. Wren eats her apple slices first, slowly, without telling anybody, and she feels good and strong inside. Just like Daniel asking for vegetables and water for ten days, Wren learned that small, quiet choices make a heart strong.
